This upper limit is allowed only if the total number of data resources does not exceed 250 across all event selectors. Examples:+ A trail with 5 event selectors, each configured with 50 data resources, is allowed. (5\*50=250) <br />+ A trail with 5 event selectors, 3 of which are configured with 50 data resources, 1 of which is configured with 99 data resources, and 1 of which is configured with 1 data resource, is also allowed. ((3\*50)\+1\+99=250) <br />+ A trail configured with 5 event selectors, all of which are configured with 100 data resources, is not allowed. (5\*100=500) <br />Event selectors apply only to trails. For event data stores, you must use advanced event selectors.<br />This quota cannot be increased.<br />The quota does not apply if you choose to log data events on all resources, such as all S3 buckets or all Lambda functions."
